items.title: Phase 0: add the manifest extract script and freeze the manifest against current source
items.context: Add scripts/extract-cli-engine-english-manifest.mjs (per the plan's required command shape) that scans packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts and emits the line-level manifest (columns: translationId, sourceLine, surface, chineseSource, proposedEnglish, reviewStatus). Regenerate against the CURRENT source (767 Chinese lines), re-anchor sourceLine, add the 5 rows missing since the 762-row snapshot, carry over the approved English from the plan doc, and keep M668/M669/M750 marked behavior-sensitive (out of scope here). Implementation may not start until every Chinese line maps to an approved row. relatedDocs: docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md.

items.title: Phase 1: translate the public CLI surface of cli-engine.ts and update affected tests
items.context: Replace Chinese with the approved English for command descriptions, Zod .describe() values, printHelp labels/examples, validation error text, unknown-command suggestions, and story/worktree next-step hints. Do NOT touch M668/M669/M750. Update any test that asserts the old Chinese output. Preserve command names, enum values, JSON keys, identifiers, and the -> Next: hint style from the plan.

items.title: Phase 2: translate internal comments in cli-engine.ts
items.context: After the public surface is stable, translate the remaining Chinese comments in cli-engine.ts, preserving technical meaning. Do not rewrite logic while translating comments.

items.title: Phase 3: add a no-new-Chinese gate smoke test
items.context: Add english-open-source-surface-smoke that fails when new Chinese appears in active source and active docs, with explicit allowlists for: this review document, generated translation manifests, legacy/archive docs, and migration-compatibility tests that still assert old output. Wire it into the verify/test surface.

items.title: Phase 4: translate related active docs and archive historical Chinese
items.context: Translate active docs that explain current behavior (README.md, docs/guide.md, docs/guide-hooks.md, and active files under docs/requirements/decisions/). Move historical Chinese-only material to explicit legacy/archive locations instead of mixing it into active open-source docs. Scope: active docs only; the plan doc itself and generated manifests are allowlisted, not retranslated.
